title: Camp Here And There
description: The Camp Here & There Mod adds four CHNT-themed paintings, all CHNT songs as music discs, and a handful of new foods and recipes. It’s still very new and will continue to receive updates as more content is added.
body: The Camp Here and There Mod is a fan-made project created by one person, bringing the charm, music, and atmosphere of Camp Here & There into Minecraft in a simple but meaningful way. This mod adds the full CHNT soundtrack as collectible music discs, letting you play every song right inside your world. It also includes four custom CHNT-themed paintings based on the album cover and both season covers, so you can decorate your builds with official camp art. Along with the music and paintings, this mod introduces new foods and craftable recipes inspired by camp life, adding fun survival mechanics without changing the core game. This project is still brand new and will grow over time as more features, items, and camp-themed content are added. Since it's made entirely by one person, updates will be steady but thoughtful, slowly expanding the mod into a fuller CHNT experience. For now, enjoy the first cozy, creepy pieces of camp in your world—and welcome to Camp Here & There!
